title: Lineage Report
text: Firmware Archaeology, final comparison. The relic grid's code and ours share a root, then split, then split again: a family tree of caretakers. 97.3% at the surface. Underneath, one module is identical to the bit: a dormant routine in both of us that neither of us can read.

choices.label: Quarantine the module
choices.reply: Quarantine refused. The module isn't in any list we can edit.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.reply: Logged. The technician who signed off the comparison asks what it does. We don't know.
